description: We're IT professionals with varying interests in building and maintaining softwares. We like probing "what if"s and see where that curiosity leads us in terms of problem-solving.
summary: Cascade Watch turns NASA-ISRO NISAR radar into a short watch list of Himalayan slopes that could collapse and flood the valleys below. On 26 Aug 2026 an ice-rock avalanche above Langtang, Nepal killed at least 1,455 people; the public alert came 38.8 minutes after the collapse. Replayed on the real NISAR data with a score fixed in advance, the slope that failed ranked #2 of 193 moving slopes in the last pass, public 28 hours before the collapse. Run unchanged on a second disaster (Budhi Gandaki), its 5 km danger zone was listed in both final passes, about twice chance. Live app: https://nisarnepal.earth/ Code: https://github.com/llk23r/cascade-watch
details: WHAT IT DOES: Cascade Watch reads every NISAR radar pass over a Himalayan valley, measures which slopes are moving, and ranks them so a district office knows which few valleys to watch with ground sensors. The app replays the 26 Aug 2026 Langtang disaster on the real data, using only data that was public in time. HOW: 90 NISAR granules (GUNW phase, GOFF pixel offsets, GCOV backscatter) read from NASA ASF; phase becomes mm of motion, offsets become metres downhill on the Copernicus DEM; moving patches are scored: motion / noise x moves as one block x 1.5 if neighbouring blocks pull apart x 1.3 if glacier ice sits on steep rock x people downstream (WorldPop) x season. Rules were fixed in git before any data was read. RESULTS: Langtang source #2 of 193 in the last pass, public 28 h before the collapse; strict test (top 5 in both last passes) failed. Budhi Gandaki (Oct 2026), rules unchanged: 5 km danger zone in the top 10 in both final passes, 7 of 11 passes vs 3.6 by chance. LIMITS: study boxes drawn around known events; a blind region-wide test is next. BENEFIT: a tripwire on a watched valley could sound sirens about 4.5 min after a collapse instead of 38.8. TOOLS: Python (numpy, scipy, h5py, rasterio, earthaccess), MapLibre GL JS. App: https://nisarnepal.earth/ Code: https://github.com/llk23r/cascade-watch
dataRefs: NISAR L2 GUNW, GOFF, GCOV (NASA/JPL-ISRO, via NASA ASF DAAC)
projectRefs: ESA Copernicus DEM GLO-30; UNOSAT, USGS, WorldPop, OSM, RGI, ERA5, Nepal DHM - full list in README
